newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering sees ongong pleasing results in Q4 96.
newsitem.headline: Schering sees ongong pleasing results in Q4 96.

text.p: German drugs group Schering AG said on Monday it expects its pleasing sales and profit developments to continue in the fourth quarter of 1996.

In a speech prepared for delivery, Schering chief financial officer Klaus Pohle said global sales should rise to around 5.2 billion marks ($3.5 billion) in 1996 compared with 1995's sales of 4.65 billion marks.
In light of the group's strong performance, the board will consider proposing an increase in the dividend to two marks for the 1996 business year from 1.55 marks in 1995.
Schering's shares are nominally valued at five marks per share.
The group also said adjusted net profit is in line with expectations. ($ = 1.503 German Marks)
